Digestion and Absorption
Nutrient digestion requires a controlled process of mechanical and chemical breakdown, with 
subsequent enzymatic and secretory responses that facilitate nutrient absorption. Carbohydrate 
digestion requires adequate amylase to convert starches into disaccharides, which then undergo 
further hydrolysis into monosaccharides. Monosaccharides are absorbed through a process of 
either diffusion or active transport. Dietary fats require the action of lipase, which results in the
